name: Standing hamstring curl

phases.name: left curl
phases.cue: Shift onto your right foot and curl your left heel up behind you, pulling your elbows back

phases.name: left out
phases.cue: Step your left foot back out wide and reach your arms forward

phases.name: right curl
phases.cue: Shift onto your left foot and curl your right heel up, squeezing your shoulder blades

phases.name: right out
phases.cue: Step your right foot back out wide and reach forward again

formTips: Shift your weight over the standing foot as the other heel comes up
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top
Pull your elbows back past your sides and squeeze your shoulder blades
Lean forward slightly with a flat back
commonMistakes: Swinging the knee forward instead of curling the heel
Letting the arms flap instead of pulling back
